goals.title: Draft a reply to one request
goals.summary: A reply drafted to one support request, for you to read before it goes.
goals.text: Draft a reply to the request from [customer] about [their problem]. Keep the tone [friendly or formal] and say clearly what we will do and by when [date]. Leave it as a draft for me; do not send it.

goals.title: Sort open requests by urgency
goals.summary: All open requests in order of urgency, with one line on each.
goals.text: List all open support requests sorted from most to least urgent. Give one plain line on each: who asked, what about, how long it has waited, and why you ranked it there.

goals.title: Replies for old requests
goals.summary: A draft reply for every request older than a number of days.
goals.text: Find every open request older than [number] days. For each one, draft a reply that apologises for the wait and answers the question as far as we can. Keep all of them as drafts for me to read; do not send anything.

goals.title: Most common questions this month
goals.summary: The three questions asked most this month, each with a standard answer.
goals.text: Find the three most common questions customers asked this month. For each, say how many times it came up and suggest a standard answer I can reuse. Write the answers as drafts for me to approve.
